fx_manifest.attribution: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates.
fx_manifest.use_terms: Federal Reserve Board website information is public domain unless otherwise indicated. No exception marked for this series. Attribution requested. No logo or seal used.
fx_manifest.limitations: SGD per USD noon New York buying rate for cable transfers. Reference rate, not executable spot or FX total return. Latest vintage, not point-in-time revision-safe data. FX return uses inverse quote: USD per SGD. No FX hedge, rate differential or conversion fee model.
fx_manifest.dependence_note: Joint listed-ETF/FX covariance fitted on common weekly dates. Weekly property dependence is assumed through its user-set equity shock correlation; property/FX correlation is induced, not separately estimated from quarterly property data. Daily FX is NY noon while ETF NAV is close, so observations are not synchronous.
